name: State
summary: Lets an object alter its behaviour when its internal state changes, so that it appears to change its class.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Context
roles.summary: Holds the current state, and delegates the state dependent behaviour to it.

roles.name: State
roles.summary: Declares the behaviour that varies with the state of the context.

roles.name: ConcreteState
roles.summary: Implements the behaviour associated with one state of the context.
